name: f28m35h52c1_m3
description: TI F28M35H52C1 (Concerto) master subsystem: Cortex-M3 at up to 100 MHz, GNU Arm toolchain (register-level C, no TI libraries), Renode dual-core platform (use with f28m35h52c1_c28 for the control subsystem)

image.loader: sysbus LoadELF @{elf} false m3; m3 VectorTableOffset 0
image.notes: m3.ld links the code at the flash entry 0x00200030 (put a naked entry function in section .entry that sets SP and branches to main) and the vector table in .vectors (set VTOR to it). See tools/concerto/tests/m3_ipc.c.

renode.notes: Two CPUs in one machine (m3 Cortex-M3, c28 C28x): every address is per CPU; monitor reads name it ('sysbus ReadDoubleWord 0x20008000 m3'). The M3 boots through the M-Boot ROM stub to flash 0x00200030 and starts the C28 with the IPC boot command (MTOCIPCCOM 0x13, MTOCIPCBOOTMODE 1 = RAM word 0x0, 2 = flash word 0x13FFF0, MTOCIPCSET 0x80000001), or 'ipc StartC28 <word>'. Shared S0-S7 RAM: M3 0x20008000 = C28 word 0xC000. Pins: 'pins RecordPin n', 'pins PinFrequency n'. Docs: tools/concerto/PERIPHERALS.md.

reference.simulator: none; checked with register-level dual-core tests (tools/concerto/tests)
